title: The Night Before the Final Battle
next_chapter_hook: When all were waiting for dawn, those eyes that had slept for millennia finally spoke the name that sent a chill through Chen Ji's entire body—Cang Yutian. Do you think you're the only one playing games?

text.content: Deep within the pitch-black cave, eerie pale-blue veins pulsed along the rock walls like some ancient blood vessels. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, chest heaving violently—the sound of the stone slab shattering beneath his foot still echoing in his ears. The tattered Tianji Record pressed against his chest was radiating an unprecedented blazing light. "You've finally come." A hoarse, ancient voice rang out from within the brilliance. Chen Ji looked up sharply—Mo Xiansheng's ethereal form had manifested upon the yellowed pages, those clouded eyes now reflecting a long-lost gleam of vitality. "Let me see what price you've paid to reach this point." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul gazed at Chen Ji as if piercing through all his secrets.

dialogue.content: "Junior Chen Ji greets Mo Xiansheng." Chen Ji suppressed the turmoil in his heart and bowed respectfully, yet within those calm, water-like eyes lay countless questions. He knew this seemingly fragmented guardian understood all the truths of the Tianji Record, yet only revealed what needed to be said at the right moments. "Master mentioned that 'this choice determines all lives and deaths'—what does this mean?" Mo Xiansheng's form wavered slightly, an enigmatic smile appearing on his aged face: "The literal meaning. Do you think your arrival here was your own choice? No—the Tianji Record guided you here. And I've slumbered for ten thousand years, waiting precisely for this moment—for someone capable of bearing the complete Tianji Record."

text.content: "The complete... Tianji Record?" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. From the moment he'd obtained the first fragment, every scroll had come through trials of blood and fire—he never dared hope to one day assemble them all. Mo Xiansheng's voice arrived like an echo from antiquity, heavy with temporal weariness: "Indeed, what you hold is the first page; what I inhabit is the second. And the remaining portions..." He paused, gaze drifting toward the impenetrable darkness deeper within the cave, "lie within the hands of the enemy you are about to face." Chen Ji's breath caught. That name—the ultimate chess master Cang Yutian—pressed against his heart like a massive stone. Despite orchestrating schemes across the world for so long, he'd never truly glimpsed that man's hidden cards.

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian is no ordinary adversary." Mo Xiansheng seemed to read Chen Ji's thoughts, his remnant soul trembling slightly. "He possesses a fragment of the Tianji Record called 'Destiny.' This page concerns no prophecy—only rewriting. He can forcibly alter others' fate trajectories, keeping enemies who should have died alive, causing perfectly laid plans to collapse entirely." Chen Ji felt a chill run down his spine. If the opponent truly wielded such power, then all his previous schemes... "Don't panic." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly dropped low. "'Destiny' is formidable, yet carries one fatal flaw—it demands at least thirty years of the user's lifespan as payment. Each use ages him further, which explains why he's rarely employed it in recent years. But now..." A trace of worry flickered in Mo Xiansheng's eyes. "This time, he seems to have made some kind of resolve."

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent, mind racing. Thirty years of lifespan... Cang Yutian willing to pay such a price meant this gamble far exceeded his expectations. He rose slowly, eyes blazing: "Master, whose fate does Cang Yutian wish to rewrite?" Mo Xiansheng offered no direct reply, asking instead: "Do you know what the true source of the Tianji Record's power is?" Chen Ji froze. Heavenly Fate, foresight ability, fragments... he'd learned of these, but the true source? Mo Xiansheng sighed: "Possibility. The Tianji Record's essence is recording and manipulating the branching possibilities of all things in existence. Each collapsed branch releases tremendous energy. And what Cang Yutian desires is absolute control of this power—forcing all possibilities to collapse into the one that favors him."

choice.prompt: Facing the approaching ultimate confrontation, Chen Ji must make crucial strategic deployments. At this moment, he needs to decide his primary course of action:

choices.description: Strike before Cang Yutian fully prepares, seize the initiative, disrupt his arrangements. Trade defense for offense, seek weaknesses amid chaos.
choices.visible_cost: May expose our strength, alerting Cang Yutian prematurely
choices.visible_reward: May disrupt enemy rhythm, seizing the initiative
choices.risk_hint: If Cang Yutian was already prepared, we may fall into his trap instead

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's words faded, a faint tremor came from beyond the cave. His brow furrowed slightly—this timing was too coincidental. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul also took on a grave expression: "It seems your choice has attracted the attention of certain existences." Chen Ji let out a cold laugh: "Good, let them hear our footsteps." He strode toward the cave entrance, his silhouette stretching long in the ethereal blue light. The chess game had begun; there was no turning back. An aggressive offense might be the best way to disrupt Cang Yutian's arrangements.

choices.description: Prioritize securing current positions, rally all allies to strengthen defenses. Rest while waiting for the enemy's exhaustion, bide time until Cang Yutian reveals weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: May grant Cang Yutian more preparation time
choices.visible_reward: Can ensure ally safety, facilitating concentrated force
choices.risk_hint: If Cang Yutian chooses to defeat us piecemeal, we may fall into passivity

text.content: "Well done." Mo Xiansheng nodded slightly, a flash of approval in his remnant soul. "Maintaining composure at such a moment—you surpass Cang Yutian of old." Chen Ji offered no reply, instead rapidly issuing orders. Solid defense wasn't cowardice—it was about gathering all strength for the critical moment. He needed time—to contact Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, consolidate all available resources, weaving a net capable of trapping this beast before Cang Yutian launched his fatal strike. Defense, after all, is the best offense.

choices.description: Deliberately reveal weaknesses, lure Cang Yutian or his subordinates into our prepared battlefield. Exploit terrain and formation advantages to encircle and annihilate the enemy.
choices.visible_cost: Need to sustain certain losses as bait
choices.visible_reward: Can draw the enemy into a battlefield environment favorable to us
choices.risk_hint: If the bait isn't convincing enough, it may be seen through

text.content: "Luring the enemy?" A hint of playfulness flickered in Mo Xiansheng's eyes. "You're becoming more like those old foxes by the day." The corner of Chen Ji's lips curved upward, that smile hiding countless calculations. The key to luring the enemy deep wasn't about showing weakness, but making them believe it was genuine strength. He had already planned it—let Su Qingyao deliberately expose her whereabouts, using her status as the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow as bait, which would definitely attract Cang Yutian's trusted confidants. As long as the enemy stepped into the preset formation's range, they would be like a turtle in a jar. Of course, this also meant Su Qingyao would face enormous risk. But a cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes—whoever dares to touch her, he will make them pay ten times the price.

Just then, subtle footsteps echoed from the shadows at the cave entrance. Chen Ji's expression instantly became alert, his right hand already pressing against the sword hilt at his waist. However, the next moment, a familiar figure walked out from the darkness—it was Su Qingyao. She wore a light cyan long dress, her hair coiled high, her expression cold as frost, yet when those bright eyes landed on Chen Ji, a trace of subtle softness flickered within them. "I knew you'd be here." Su Qingyao's voice was cold and clear, but carried an undetectable hint of concern. "The decisive battle is imminent, yet you hide here alone. What are you planning?" Chen Ji looked at this woman who had come close to the truth multiple times but was skillfully deflected by him each time, feeling a complex sentiment rising in his heart. This woman was too smart, too persistent. He had to be even more careful.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, what exactly are you hiding?" Su Qingyao stepped forward, her gaze blazing like fire, staring fixedly at Chen Ji's eyes. "From the moment you entered the Tianqing Sect, I felt something was off about you. How could a Servant Disciple possess such temperament and means? What are you scheming by deliberately hiding your strength?" Chen Ji met her gaze, a gentle smile forming on his face, that smile appearing utterly harmless. "Senior Sister Su is overthinking. I'm just atrash, what could I possibly have to hide?" Su Qingyao snorted coldly, about to retort, when suddenly her gaze fell upon the scroll emanating a faint glow in Chen Ji's arms, her pupils contracting sharply. "What is that?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained unruffled. Damn, I forgot to put this away. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed faintly within the pages: "It seems the gears of fate have begun to turn."

text.content: Su Qingyao walked closer slowly, her gaze always locked onto that ancient scroll emanating a诡异的 glow. Her cultivation was far beyond Chen Ji's, at this moment she only needed one thought to snatch that thing and investigate it thoroughly. Yet she didn't. Her fingers trembled slightly, her eyes flickering with struggle and pain. After a long while, she raised her head, her voice hoarse: "I won't ask anymore." Chen Ji was stunned. Su Qingyao continued, her voice carrying a determination bordering on resignation: "Regardless of who you are, whatever secrets you hold... I've made my decision." She took out a crystal-clear Jade Pendant from her bosom and placed itsolemnly in Chen Ji's hand. "This was my mother's memento, it can block a lethal attack for you in critical moments. Consider it... what I owe you." Chen Ji held that warm Jade Pendant, momentarily at a loss for words. This woman, had come infinitely close to the truth, yet chose to let go.

dialogue.content: Just as the atmosphere fell into subtlety, a black figure descended silently from the cave ceiling, bringing with it a wave of cold demonic energy. Su Qingyao's expression instantly cooled, sword light flashing as she was about to strike. "Wait." Chen Ji raised his hand to stop her. The newcomer was precisely Ye Qing, the Saint of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, that woman who had been shocked by the prophecy Chen Ji had shown using the Tianji Record. Ye Qing had changed into tight night clothes today, outlining her graceful curves perfectly, yet those妖异的 purple eyes carried rare solemnity. "Chen Ji, I've found some intelligence." Her voice was very low. "Cang Yutian's movements are more bizarre than we anticipated. He secretly left his territory three days ago, destination unknown." Chen Ji's gaze instantly sharpened. Unknown destination? This wasn't Cang Yutian's style. That man calculated everything meticulously, never making a journey without purpose.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly echoed in Chen Ji's mind, carrying unprecedented solemnity: "He's gone to find the 'Heavenly Fate Key'." Chen Ji's body froze abruptly. Heavenly Fate Key—that was his missing sister, Chen Nian! The Holy Sect had taken her as some kind of tool, he had been investigating secretly all along but never found her exact whereabouts. And now, Cang Yutian was actually searching for her too? Mo Xiansheng continued: "Chen Nian is special. Her existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight—any prophetic visions involving her are blurred. Cang Yutian wants her precisely because of this. As long as he controls Chen Nian, he can completely shield himself from the Tianji Record's foresight about him. At that point, you will become a blind man." Chen Ji's hands unconsciously clenched tight, his knuckles whitening from the force. His sister, the sister he had wronged for years... she absolutely cannot fall into that man's hands.

choice.prompt: After learning that Cang Yutian was pursuing his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts, Chen Ji had to make a choice:

choices.description: Immediately suspend current deployment and personally search for Chen Nian. His sister was his only weakness, there could be no mistakes.
choices.visible_reward: Can ensure Chen Nian's safety and eliminate hidden dangers
choices.risk_hint: May fall right into Cang Yutian's trap, being lured away from the main objective

text.content: "I'm going to find her." Chen Ji's voice was low and firm, permitting no argument. Su Qingyao's expression shifted slightly, her mouth opening to speak, but she was stopped by Chen Ji's gaze. Ye Qing, however, looked at him thoughtfully, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of her lips: "So you have a weakness too, Chen Ji." Chen Ji ignored her teasing and turned to Mo Xiansheng: "Sir, tell me her location." Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment before finally speaking: "The Extreme Northern Ice Plain, beneath ten-thousand-year mystic ice. That is the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, and where Chen Nian is imprisoned. But I must warn you—Cang Yutian departed earlier than you, you may not be able to catch up." Chen Jisneered一声, a fierce light flashing in his eyes: "Then we'll see whose speed is faster, his or my sword."

result_nodes.description: Trust allies to protect Chen Nian, proceed with the original strategic deployment. Private emotions cannot be allowed to affect the overall situation.
result_nodes.visible_reward: Can ensure strategic integrity and preserve combat strength
result_nodes.risk_hint: If something happens to Chen Nian, may affect Chen Ji's state of mind

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened them again, those eyes had already restored their usual calmness and depth. "Ye Qing." He turned to the Demonic Path Saint. "I need you to depart immediately for the Extreme Northern Ice Plain, using your 'Demonic Path Mist' to protect Chen Nian." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, seemingly surprised by his composure. "Aren't you afraid I'll take the opportunity to take her away?" Chen Ji stared directly into her eyes, saying calmly: "You won't." Ye Qing was stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter: "Interesting, Chen Ji, you're getting more and more interesting. Fine, I答应 you." She turned and vanished into the night like a shadow. Su Qingyao watched this scene, a indescribable feeling rising in her heart. How many hidden cards did this man still have that she didn't know about?

result_nodes.description: Lead a team to rescue Chen Nian personally, while letting Su Qingyao continue with the original strategic deployment. Surrender neither side.
result_nodes.visible_cost: Divided forces, both sides may face pressure
result_nodes.visible_reward: Balance family affection and overall situation
result_nodes.risk_hint: May be unable to give full effort on both sides

text.content: "I have a solution." Chen Ji's voice was calm, yet carried an unquestionable resolve. "Senior Sister Su, take your people to continue the original deployment and attract Cang Yutian's attention. Ye Qing goes to protect Chen Nian. And I..." He paused, a dangerous arc appearing at the corner of his lips. "I'm going to meet Cang Yutian." Su Qingyao looked up sharply, her eyes full of shock: "Are you insane? Going alone to face the ultimate Chess Player?" Chen Ji shook his head: "I'm not going to kill him, but to stall him. As long as he's still focused on me, he won't have the energy to worry about Chen Nian's side. This is called 'saving Zhao by attacking Wei'." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly within the pages, letting out a low sigh: "You child, just like him in those days, always treating yourself as the only chess piece."

Outside the cave, the sky had already begun to glow with the pale light of dawn. The countdown to the final battle was ticking away, second by second. Chen Ji stood at the cave entrance, letting the morning wind flutter his robes, his gaze deep and unfathomable as an abyss. He thought of many things—the journey fromtrash disciple to mastermind of the world, from Tianji Fragment to the ultimate chess player he was about to face. All along this path, he had never retreated. But this time was different. This time, the enemy he faced was not ordinary—it was a man who, like himself, possessed partial power of the Tianji Record. Cang Yutian. That name stirred tumultuous waves in Chen Ji's heart. He did not know what other trump cards the man held, but he knew this battle would determine the fate of all.

dialogue.content: "Child, before you set off, there is one more thing I must tell you." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned exceptionally grave, "Regarding Cang Yutian's final trump card." Chen Ji turned around, his gaze burning as he stared at the ancient scroll. Mo Xiansheng slowly said, "The page of the Tianji Record in his possession is called 'Cause and Effect Reversal.' Within a short time, all damage inflicted upon him can be reflected back onto the attacker. In other words—" his voice dropped low, "during this period, anyone who attacks him will be killed by their own power." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. What did this mean? It meant that during the time Cang Yutian activated this ability, he could only defend, not attack. But given Cang Yutian's strength, he remained nearly invincible even in a defensive state.

text.content: "Does this ability have any limitations?" Chen Ji asked in a deep voice. Mo Xiansheng pondered for a moment: "'Cause and Effect Reversal' requires at least the time of one incense stick to activate, and during activation, Cang Yutian must remain absolutely still, unable to move or attack. This is a fatal flaw—but only if you can prevent him from sensing your intentions during that incense stick's time." Chen Ji fell into deep thought. One incense stick... prevent him from sensing... this was nearly an impossible task. Unless— a thought suddenly flashed through his mind, and a dangerous smile slowly curved his lips. Unless he didn't need to approach Cang Yutian at all. He could let someone else carry out this task. Someone Cang Yutian would never expect.

dialogue.content: Just then, a sinister laugh echoed from the depths of the cave. "What a magnificent scheme, Chen Ji." The voice was aged and hoarse, carrying an indescribable sense of eeriness. Chen Ji's expression instantly darkened—this voice, he knew too well. Ling Yuan, the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, that old fox who appeared to shelter him while harboring malicious intentions, slowly emerged from the darkness. His face wore a gentle smile, but those eyes were icy cold without a trace of warmth. "I thought you were merely atrash disciple,没想到... tsk tsk, you have brought this old man so many surprises." Chen Ji's hand was already on his sword hilt, but his face remained calm: "Ling Sect Master visits at night,不知有何贵干?" Ling Yuan's smile deepened: "Of course I've come to see what grand scheme my 'good disciple' of Tianqing Sect is plotting."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan suddenly appeared, Chen Ji had to respond:

choices.description: Directly expose Ling Yuan's disguise, let him know his cards have been seen. Suppress the opponent with momentum.
choices.visible_reward: May cause Ling Yuan to retreat or reveal more flaws

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile gentle and harmless, yet inexplicably sent a chill down Ling Yuan's spine. "Ling Sect Master, you are the previous generation's successor candidate of Tianji, aren't you?" Chen Ji's voice was casual, yet like a blade piercing straight into the enemy's heart. Ling Yuan's expression instantly froze. Su Qingyao turned abruptly, gazing at this scene in disbelief. "Unfortunately, the Tianji Record chose me, not you." Chen Ji continued, each word like a nail hammering into Ling Yuan's heart, "So you bore a grudge, secretly colluding with Cang Yutian, wanting to reclaim what belongs to you. Ling Sect Master, am I right?" Ling Yuan's face twisted for an instant, then regained composure, but the killing intent in those eyes was no longer concealed. "Good, good, good." He repeated the word three times, "谁能想到 this old man hid his secret for so many years, only to be seen through by a mere youngster."

result_nodes.description: Pretend not to know Ling Yuan's true identity, continue playing thetrash disciple, reduce the opponent's vigilance.
result_nodes.visible_cost: May let Ling Yuan gain more information
result_nodes.visible_reward: Can preserve more trump cards, wait for the right moment
result_nodes.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may already have contact with Cang Yutian

text.content: Chen Ji's expression suddenly turned fearful, hastily waving his hands: "Ling Sect Master misunderstands, 晚辈不过是随口猜测, how would I dare to disrespect the Sect Master?" His tone was excessively humble, his body even trembling slightly, looking just like a frightenedtrash disciple. Su Qingyao watched Chen Ji's act, her heart filled with mixed emotions. She knew this was Chen Ji's disguise, but seeing it every time she couldn't help thinking... if this man didn't act, it would be a waste of his talent. Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, studying Chen Ji for a long while, finally withdrawing that oppressive aura, coldly hmphing: "算你识相. However..." His gaze fell on the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's arms, a greedy light flashing in his eyes, "hand that thing over for this old man to see, how about it?" Chen Ji shook his head like a rattle drum: "这...这只是一本破书, if the Sect Master wants to see it, then see it..." As he spoke, he moved to remove the Tianji Record. A triumphant light flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes—thistrash, truly easy to deceive.

result_nodes.description: While Ling Yuan is careless, suddenly strike to subdue him. Though Ling Yuan is powerful, Chen Ji may not be without fighting chance.
result_nodes.visible_cost: May alert the snake, alert Cang Yutian
result_nodes.visible_reward: Can eliminate internal hidden dangers, obtain intelligence from Ling Yuan
result_nodes.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may have prepared in advance, fall into a counter-scheme

text.content: Before the words even finished, Chen Ji's figure had vanished from its原地. The next instant, a sword light like a startling rainbow swept toward Ling Yuan's throat. Fast, too fast. Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply, his body retreating several zhang, barely dodging this lethal strike. "You—" his face full of shock, "your strength..." Chen Ji held the long sword, killing intent blazing in his eyes: "Ling Sect Master, your废话太多了." The moment his voice fell, he pressed forward again, sword light surging toward Ling Yuan like a tide. Su Qingyao also reacted, drawing her sword to join the battle. Ling Yuan, fighting two against one, instantly fell into disadvantage. A flash of fear crossed his face, then gritting his teeth, he pulled out a pitch-black talisman from his怀— that was the lifeline Cang Yutian had given him. "Chen Ji, you think you can kill me?" He grinned sinisterly, crushing the talisman. A flash of black light, and his entire person actually vanished on the spot. Chen Ji sheathed his sword, his gaze icy cold. Ran away? Cang Yutian's methods truly permeated everywhere.

After Ling Yuan escaped, the cave fell into a brief silence. Su Qingyao sheathed her sword, her gaze toward Chen Ji carrying complex emotions. This man, from beginning to end, had been hiding his true strength. Thattrash disciple image had deceived everyone—including her. "When do you plan to tell me the truth?" Her voice was somewhat hoarse. Chen Ji turned to face her, looking into her eyes, after a moment of silence said: "等这一切结束之后." Su Qingyao gave a bitter laugh: "又是这句话." She didn't press further, instead walking to the cave entrance, gazing at the distant whitening horizon. "决战...就要开始了." Chen Ji walked to her side, standing shoulder to shoulder. The morning wind stirred both their robes, stretching their shadows long. "是啊." His voice was low, "这一战，没有退路." In the distance, the first rays of sunlight pierced through the clouds, shrouding the entire Tianqing Sect in golden light. And in places that light could not reach, countless undercurrents were surging. Cang Yutian's final trump card, about to be revealed. And Chen Ji's fate, about to usher in the most critical turning point.
